title: Virtual reality sampled pathways guide free energy calculation of protein-ligand binding
authors: Helen Deeks; Kirill Zinovjev; Jonathan Barnoud; Adrian Mulholland; Marc van der Kamp; David Glowacki
one_liner_zh: 该文结合虚拟现实交互式分子动力学与自由能采样研究蛋白-配体解离路径，虽非TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: We describe a novel two-step approach for combining cloud-mounted interactive molecular dynamics in virtual reality (iMD-VR) with free energy sampling (FES) approaches to quantitatively explore the dynamics of biological processes at the molecular level. The combined approach we refer to as the iMD-VR-FES protocol. Stage one involves using a state-of-the-art iMD-VR framework to quickly sample a diverse range of protein-ligand unbinding pathways, benefitting from the sophistication of human spatial and chemical intuition. Stage two involves using the iMD-VR-sampled pathways as initial guesses for defining a path-based reaction coordinate from which we can obtain a corresponding free energy profile using FES methods. To investigate the performance of the method, we apply iMR-VR-FES to investigate the unbinding of a benzamidine ligand from a trypsin protein. Unbinding free energies calculated using iMD-VR-FES show good internal consistency, and broadly agree with previous literature values. Moreover, the resulting free energy profiles can distinguish energetic differences corresponding to various protein-ligand conformations (e.g., helping to identifying favorable vs. unfavorable pathways) and also enable identification of metastable states along the unbinding pathways. The two-step iMD-VR-FES approach offers an intuitive way for researchers to test various hypotheses of dynamical and conformational change, in order to quickly obtain both qualitative and quantitative insight.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了一种新颖的两步方法，将云挂载的虚拟现实交互式分子动力学（iMD-VR）与自由能采样（FES）方法相结合，以定量探索分子水平上生物过程的动态。我们将这种组合方法称为iMD-VR-FES协议。第一步涉及使用最先进的iMD-VR框架快速采样多样化的蛋白质-配体解离路径，受益于人类空间和化学直觉的复杂性。第二步涉及将iMD-VR采样的路径作为初始猜测，用于定义基于路径的反应坐标，从而通过FES方法获得相应的自由能分布。为评估该方法的表现，我们应用iMD-VR-FES研究苯甲脒配体从胰蛋白酶蛋白中的解离。使用iMD-VR-FES计算的解离自由能显示出良好的内部一致性，并与先前的文献值大致相符。此外，所得的自由能分布能够区分不同蛋白质-配体构象对应的能量差异（例如，有助于识别有利与不利路径），并能够识别解离路径上的亚稳态。两步iMD-VR-FES方法为研究人员提供了一种直观的方式，以测试关于动态和构象变化的各种假设，从而快速获得定性和定量的见解。
